basis: The dashboard shows May as the lowest pumping volume month, with its bar visibly below the 10,000 m3 gridline while all other months are above it. This represents a significant deviation from the other displayed months (which range from ~17,500 to 40,000 m3). The task explicitly asks to decide between 'standard low-pumping follow-up' and 'critical low-pumping anomaly' based on the dashboard. Since May's volume is dramatically lower than all other months (appearing to be near baseline, well below the next lowest month of ~17,500 m3), this qualifies as a critical anomaly rather than a standard low-pumping case.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-pumping anomaly review
